detailed_descriptions.en: Is that a camper parked outside of Löckelle Teardown Services? Or is it… a time machine? Time Campers is a Teardown campaign expansion set in the wild west. Use creative problem solving to find and pilfer old-timey materials as you attempt to get the time machine back into working order. But beware of Charles Keerthi's new gunpowder alarms which may alert the patrolling hot air balloon to your actions. FEATURES The introduction of Nils Andrée, a time traveling camping enthusiast A new map featuring an old mining town with a gunpowder factory A new map featuring a train station, sheriff's office and ravine A suite of period appropriate tools

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Is that a camper parked outside of Löckelle Teardown Services? Or is it… a time machine?

Time Campers is a Teardown campaign expansion set in the wild west. Use creative problem solving to find and pilfer old-timey materials as you attempt to get the time machine back into working order. But beware of Charles Keerthi's new gunpowder alarms which may alert the patrolling hot air balloon to your actions.

FEATURES

  • The introduction of Nils Andrée, a time traveling camping enthusiast
  • A new map featuring an old mining town with a gunpowder factory
  • A new map featuring a train station, sheriff's office and ravine
  • A suite of period appropriate tools
